description: Source code for a class that handles configuration, processing, and response transformation for multimodal embeddings using Vertex AI within the litellm project. Contains methods for input processing, request transformation, response parsing, and usage calculation.

classes.name: VertexAIMultimodalEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for handling multimodal embedding requests and responses with Vertex AI, extending BaseEmbeddingConfig.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for OpenAI-like models, specifically 'dimensions'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters, particularly 'dimensions', to the model-specific parameter 'outputDimensionality'.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Sets up the request headers with Content-Type and Authorization token.

methods.name: bool _is_gcs_uri(self, input_str: str)
methods.description: Checks if a string is a Google Cloud Storage URI.

methods.name: bool _is_video(self, input_str: str)
methods.description: Checks if a string indicates a video file (mp4).

methods.name: bool _is_media_input(self, input_str: str)
methods.description: Determines if the input string is a media element (GCS URI or base64-encoded image).

methods.name: InstanceImage _create_image_instance(self, input_str: str)
methods.description: Creates an InstanceImage from a GCS URI or base64 string.

methods.name: InstanceVideo _create_video_instance(self, input_str: str)
methods.description: Creates an InstanceVideo from a GCS URI.

methods.name: Instance _process_input_element(self, input_element: str)
methods.description: Processes a single input element into an Instance, recognizing media types.

methods.name: tuple[Instance,bool] _try_merge_text_with_media( self, text_str: str, next_elem: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Attempts to merge a text element with a subsequent media element into a single Instance.

methods.name: List[Instance] process_openai_embedding_input( self, _input: Union[list, str] )
methods.description: Processes a list or string input into a list of Instance objects suitable for embedding requests.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for embedding, adapting input and optional parameters.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str], request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response into structured EmbeddingResponse, handling errors.

methods.name: Usage calculate_usage( self, request_data: VertexMultimodalEmbeddingRequest, vertex_predictions: MultimodalPredictions, )
methods.description: Calculates the token and media usage from the request data and predictions.

methods.name: List[Embedding] transform_embedding_response_to_openai( self, predictions: MultimodalPredictions )
methods.description: Converts model-specific predictions to OpenAI-compatible Embedding objects.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, Headers] )
methods.description: Creates a specific error instance based on an error message and HTTP status.
